title: StarTracker 1.0.5
startrackerNotes: Crafting workshop: blueprint recipes, mission sources, material quality sliders, stat previews.
Trade routes planner, refinery calculator, reputation tracker, and community Tools hub.
Market prices tab merges trade, mining, and illegal filters. Smuggler routes link to prices instead of duplicating tables.
Jump to favorites, inline row details, and UI polish beyond the color theme.
